Debloater_Subtitle: Select telemetry, bloatware, AI, and browser tweaks built directly into the module and apply them individually or in batch.
Debloater_NoneSelected: Select at least one debloat tweak to apply.

Debloat_ConsumerFeatures_Desc: Prevents automatic installation of sponsored apps and Microsoft Store suggestions
Debloat_Telemetry_Title: Disable Full Windows Telemetry & Data Collection
Debloat_Telemetry_Desc: Disables diagnostic reporting, advertising ID, tailored experiences, and DiagTrack/wermgr services
Debloat_Widgets_Desc: Terminates and uninstalls Widgets and WebExperience packages to free up RAM
Debloat_Wpbt_Desc: Blocks automatic execution of OEM binaries and drivers injected via ACPI WPBT table at boot
Debloat_ActivityHistory_Desc: Prevents Windows from publishing or uploading user activity history
Debloat_BgApps_Desc: Globally disables background execution for Microsoft Store applications
Debloat_WindowsAI_Title: Disable & Remove Windows AI Features (Copilot / Recall)
Debloat_WindowsAI_Desc: Removes Copilot, hides AI components in Settings, disables Recall and Notepad AI features
Debloat_BingSearch_Title: Disable Bing Web Search in Windows Search Bar
Debloat_BingSearch_Desc: Removes Bing web results from the Start Menu, speeding up local file searches
Debloat_Edge_Desc: Disables shopping assistant, first-run popups, promotions, widgets, and telemetry in Edge
Debloat_Brave_Title: Debloat Brave Browser (Crypto, VPN & Leo AI)
Debloat_Brave_Desc: Applies corporate policies in Brave to disable crypto wallet, VPN, Leo AI, and telemetry
